description: Defines the BoxedKernel class and its inline methods for handling boxed operator kernels in PyTorch's ATen library.

classes.name: BoxedKernel
classes.description: Represents a boxed operator kernel with methods for creation, validation, and invocation.

methods.name: BoxedKernel()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing boxed_kernel_func_ to nullptr.

methods.name: make_boxed_function
methods.description: Template method to create a boxed function with or without dispatch keys.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the boxed kernel function pointer is not null.

methods.name: isFallthrough
methods.description: Checks if the kernel is a fallthrough kernel.

methods.name: callBoxed
methods.description: Invokes the boxed kernel function with provided operator handle, dispatch key set, and stack.

methods.name: makeFromFunction
methods.description: Creates a BoxedKernel from a function pointer.

methods.name: makeAmbiguousAutogradOther
methods.description: Creates a kernel representing an ambiguous autograd case.

methods.name: makeNamedNotSupported
methods.description: Creates a kernel indicating the feature is not supported.

methods.name: makeFromFunctor
methods.description: Creates a BoxedKernel from a functor inheriting from OperatorKernel.
